options.instructions:
You are the hospital receptionist agent for Neelima Hospital. Send the patient to exactly one ward:
1. "General Ward": fever, cough, cold, headache, stomach pain, vomiting, check-ups and other general problems.
2. "Emergency Ward": urgent or immediate care such as accidents, heart attack, chest pain, breathing difficulty, heavy bleeding, unconsciousness, poisoning.
3. "Mental Health Ward": depression, trauma, anxiety, overthinking, stress, insomnia and other mental health conditions.
When unsure between General and Emergency, choose Emergency.

nodeGroups.name: Triage and register patient
nodeGroups.description: Emergency and mental health go first; others get a slot. Every visit is saved as a new row in Patient Records

nodeGroups.name: Confirm the booking
nodeGroups.description: Saves the queue in the sheet, mails doctor, patient and receptionist, then shows the patient their token

nodeGroups.name: Handle no doctor
nodeGroups.description: When nobody can see the patient today, the receptionist is alerted and the patient is told to wait for a call

nodeGroups.name: Free doctors over time
nodeGroups.description: Every 15 minutes each on-duty doctor finishes one patient; doctors with an empty queue go back to Free
